Coffee mug with print,

The design area on the mug is 80x200mm for wrap, or 80x100mm for print
on the side. The price is the same for the 2 areas.

There is approx. 10mm at the top + bottom of the cup where no print comes.

'Sublimation printing, durability throughout the cup’s lifetime. (tested to 500 washes).
Our mugs are 95mm high and 80mm in diameter.

Production standard is: 4 weekdays, you have the option to choose 0-24

order is sent the same day.
